name: Show of Force
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
narrative.objectives: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Gnoll Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Quite the armful you have.While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, Zurk.
narrative.requestItemsText: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
